cards.name: Big Insect
cards.description: A giant ant that dwells in the jungle. Powerful in terms of both ATK and DEF factor.

cards.name: Basic Insect
cards.description: Usually found travelling in swarms, this creature's ideal environment is the forest.

cards.name: Hercules Beetle
cards.description: A massive beetle with a tough hide and a dangerous horn.

cards.name: Killer Needle
cards.description: A huge bee with exceptional strength. Particularly dangerous when a swarm is encountered.

cards.name: Gokibore
cards.description: A large, spherical roach that attacks its enemies by rolling over them. Its tough defense makes it formidable foe.

cards.name: Giant Flea
cards.description: A giant blood-sucking flea that's devastating when attacking.

cards.name: Larvae Moth
cards.description: Not much in its larval from, this creature is a force to be reckoned with when it grows to become a colossal moth.

cards.name: Great Moth
cards.description: A powerful creature of the forest, this huge moth attacks its enemies by spreading poison dust with its wings.

cards.name: Perfectly Ultimate Great Moth
cards.description: The final incarnation of the ultimate insect, the Great Moth!

cards.name: Cocoon of Evolution
cards.description: This creature is capable of instantly evolving larvae into adults.

cards.name: Nightmare Scorpion
cards.description: A very toxic creature that induces nightmares and attacks its victims with four poison- tipped stingers.

cards.name: Spiked Snail
cards.description: Evolving from the powers of darkness, this snail has arms and legs that allow swift attacks against its enemies.

cards.name: Winged Cleaver
cards.description: This creature attacks by swinging around its sickle-like arms.

cards.name: Kumootoko
cards.description: A massive, intelligent spider that traps its enemies with webbing.

cards.name: Petit Moth
cards.description: Nobody has any idea what creature may spawn from this mysterious larva.

cards.name: Jirai Gumo
cards.description: A monster spider that dwells under the earth.

cards.name: Dungeon Worm
cards.description: Hidden under the floors of a labyrinth, it swallows any who pass above.

cards.name: Leghul
cards.description: Not a very powerful monster despite its large fangs and spikes.

cards.name: Ganigumo
cards.description: A spider armed with scissors to attack anything that it traps in its web.

cards.name: Alinsection
cards.description: A stag beetle monster with saw-toothed horn and arms.

cards.name: Insect Soldiers of the Sky
cards.description: Insect soldiers that attack in swarms.

cards.name: Cockroach Knight
cards.description: A cockroach warrior that hides in small spaces and emerges to attack enemies.

cards.name: Kuwagata α
cards.description: A violent stag beetle with a razor-like cutter.

cards.name: Korogashi
cards.description: This creature rolls massive objects to crush its enemies.

cards.name: Kattapillar
cards.description: Attacks by blowing webs at its enemies. Nobody knows whats the final form of this insect might be.

cards.name: Man-eater Bug
cards.description: A creature that slices and dices with its scissors and feeds off its victims.

cards.name: Gale Dogra
cards.description: A huge moth that generates a whirlwind containing poison dust.

cards.name: Kwagar Hercules
cards.description: An insect monster with the jaws of a stag and the horn of a beetle.

cards.name: Minar
cards.description: A monster with four highly dexterous arms for executing separate attacks.

cards.name: Kamakiriman
cards.description: A man-shaped mantis with two razor sharp scythes.

cards.name: Needle Worm
cards.description: A larva with steel spikes to attack the unwary.

cards.name: Giant Scorpion of the Tundra
cards.description: A rare scarlet scorpion that can be found in the tundra — not in the desert.

cards.name: Bladefly
cards.description: A monster fly that swoops down with sharp sword-like arms extended out front.

cards.name: Hunter Spider
cards.description: A hunter that uses its spider web to entrap its enemies.

cards.name: Acid Crawler
cards.description: A gigantic caterpillar that spits acid capable of melting almost anything.

cards.name: Javelin Beetle
cards.description: A creature with lethal scissors that cut through almost anything.
